messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High error rate + latency spike for /v1/generate (customer=AcmeCorp). KV cache miss-rate increased ~12x and continuous-batching window grew unexpectedly. Investigating. Incident: https://redwood.incidents/INC-12345

maya: paging SRE oncall — @dmitri you up? this looks like a KV/cache amplification pattern we saw before.

sam: I'm on call, grabbing dashboards now. seeing host group acme-slice-1 with 95th latency > 6s and token generation errors.

dmitri: oncall here. checking kv cache metrics and evictions. initial observation: prefix key skew caused batch coalescing to blow up. evictions spiked, GC CPU high.

priya: logs look like continuous_batch.window extended on some routes from 512 -> 4096. that + cold cache = huge batch sizes and backpressure.

alice: can we short-circuit batching for AcmeCorp while we triage? per-customer override should be quickest.

sam: agreed. I'll apply per-customer flag to disable continuous batching for AcmeCorp. doing via admin API.

sam: runbook command:

```
# disable continuous batching for tenant
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/flags/set \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}' \
  -d '{"tenant":"acme","flag":"kv_continuous_batching","value":false}'
```

sam: applied. propagation to edge completed in ~15s.

deploy-bot: Flag update propagated to 8 regions. rollout status: OK.

maya: nice. metrics?

dmitri: canary hosts (acme-slice-1-a/b) show latency 95p down from ~6s to ~380ms, error rate back to baseline. eviction rate dropping.

priya: good quick mitigation. we should still roll a code hotfix to prevent window inflation. proposing hotfix: clamp batch_window to max 1024 and add guard when prefix-mismatch-hotkey > threshold.

alice: I have a tiny patch to clamp window and avoid growth when kv miss rate > 5%. also adds debug logging. will push as emergency hotfix branch.

sam: recommend canary deployment: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 10m steps. also keep per-customer flag as a safety net.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: refs/heads/hotfix/kv-window-clamp -> staging -> canary. Canary group: acme-slice-1-c,d (5%). Plan: 10m observation, metric checks: latency, evictions, error-rate.

dmitri: adding automated metric checks to canary pipeline:

```
- kv.evictions:<5x increase
- 95p latency:<1s
- error-rate:<0.5% above baseline
```

maya: also document the per-customer override command in the incident doc so support can do it if needed.

sam: canary looks good so far. after 8m 95p down 60%, evictions down 80%. promoting to 25%.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion to 25% done.

priya: telemetry shows a subset of customers with long common prefixes (chat threads with huge system prompts) — we should add a long-term mitigation: prefix-aware batching limits and telemetry to surface high-family-prefix sizes.

alice: hotfix merged. rolling to 100%. keeping per-tenant override ON for Acme until end of day.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete. Post-rollout checks OK. No regressions detected.

sam: starting post-mortem draft: root cause = prefix skew + lack of window clamp + missing guard on continuous-batching growth. Immediate mitigations: per-tenant flag, hotfix clamp, telemetry dashboards.

dmitri: action items:
- Priya to add prefix-size telemetry and alert rule (P1)
- Alice to add unit + integration tests to prevent window > 2048 (P0)
- Sam to run customer-impact follow-up with Acme support (P1)
- Maya to update runbook with per-tenant override snippet and rollback steps (P1)

maya: will update runbook and incident doc. linking INC ticket and support notes: https://redwood.incidents/INC-12345/notes

sam: Acme engineering contacted, they confirm degraded UX earlier today, happy with mitigation. support will follow up for any persisted failures.

priya: leaving a note: consider defaulting batch_window to conservative value for new tenants.

alice: adding test coverage now. will open PR against main.

incident-bot: Incident INC-12345 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Timeline and initial RCA being drafted. Participants, please add notes to the incident doc.

sam: closing channel for active mitigation. will re-open if anything pops. :thumbsup:

maya: great work everyone — clean mitigations and good coordination.

dmitri: handing off to SRE rotations for follow-up and postmortem. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
